headline: Google Maps adds AI trip-planning features
summary: Google Maps' new Ask Maps feature can build real-time trip itineraries and is rolling out today on Android and iOS.

claims.statement: Google Maps can now build trip itineraries with real-time details for each stop via Ask Maps.

sources.quote: Google Maps can now build trip itineraries with real-time details about each stop

claims.statement: Ask Maps can plan trips ranging from a day trip to a multi-day road trip.

sources.quote: You could use Ask Maps to plan a holiday shopping day trip or something more complex, like a three-day road trip featuring coastal hikes and oceanfront dining.

claims.statement: The Ask Maps features start rolling out today on Android and iOS.

sources.quote: Google’s Ask Maps features start rolling out today on Android and iOS.
